image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a tiger beetle (Cicindelinae) on a sandy, gravelly surface. The beetle has a dark, metallic body with distinct pale/cream-colored markings on the elytra and thorax. It features long, slender legs, prominent compound eyes, and very long filiform antennae.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Large, curved mandibles are visible at the front of the head, consistent with the predatory nature of tiger beetles.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Filiform antennae extending well beyond the midbody.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both antennae are visible, thread-like (filiform), and extend significantly past the middle of the body length.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Six slender cursorial legs enabling rapid pursuit.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body (head, thorax, abdomen).
